genmol_comparator_measured.note_on_those_cells: mean_of_successful is UNDEFINED where n_success is 0, so those cells are 'COMPOSE produced a molecule, GenMol produced none', not a score comparison. Three of the four are also COMPOSE's own historically exhausted cells.

primary_statistic.compose: mean of the 3 replicates +- sd, REPORTED WITH n_success
primary_statistic.rule: compare mean to mean at equal N. Never best-to-best, never across different N.

checks: reconciled_charged_calls is a LOWER BOUND in both directions: locks are written per round INDEX, so a round that rolled back and was redone rewrites its own lock
run_cell reads the volume with no volume.reload(), so a restarted container can read a stale view and overwrite newer state
reconciliation.hard_stop: uncertain accounting refuses to continue; an uncertain call is never a free call
reconciliation.tool: scripts/t4_all_runs_reconcile.py (reads locks across EVERY run on each volume)

secondary_statistic.labelling: clearly marked SECONDARY; never the headline

payload.why_sealed_before_the_numbers: The GenMol baseline measured that best-of-N is biased and its bias GROWS with N: the same 240 runs move 10.4 kcal/mol across one fixed cell set purely by switching statistic. Choosing the statistic after seeing replicate 2 would be selecting the number that flatters us.
